steps.text: Cut the provolone into cubes.
Thread onto toothpicks with a folded strip of chargrilled eggplant, an olive and a strip of roasted capsicum.
Pile onto a board with sliced Italian bread and a small bowl of olive oil for dipping.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager to a light batter.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.
Pat the haloumi dry, dip in the batter and fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden. Drain on paper.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, haloumi, crema and salsa.
Whisk the flour with the cold soda water to a light batter.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.
Pat the haloumi dry, dip in the batter and fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden. Drain on paper.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, haloumi, crema and salsa.
Fold the chargrilled eggplant and provolone onto a big board.
Warm the olives gently in olive oil and spoon over.
Add the artichoke hearts and strips of roasted capsicum.
Tear the bread for mopping up the oil.

veg.n: Diner leftovers king brown mushroom bites

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into thick 2cm coins.
Sear hard in a very hot pan with the oil until well browned on both sides.
Toss in the melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt.
Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

veg.n: Paid-for roast capsicum and ricotta crostini

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus extra to finish
salt and cracked black pepper, to taste

steps.text: Slice the baguette into 16 thin rounds and brush with olive oil.
Toast at 200C until golden.
Whip the ricotta with lemon zest, salt and a drizzle of olive oil until smooth.
Spread on the toasts and top each with a folded strip of chargrilled capsicum.
Finish with a sliver of pickled onion, cracked pepper and parsley leaves.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pan.
Fry the bread slowly until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt and cracked pepper.
Brush the mushrooms with oil, season with salt and pepper and roast at 200C until tender and dark.
Rest for a few minutes, then slice thin.
Mix the barbecue sauce with mayonnaise.
Pile the mushrooms into the buns with the sauce and a slice of cheese.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until browned and dry.
Hollow out the cob loaf, keeping the lid.
Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, mushrooms, cheddar and soup mix.
Fill the loaf and wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C.
Tear the hollowed bread into chunks for dipping.
Whisk the flour, milk and salt into a thick batter and coat the cauliflower florets.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce, toss the cauliflower through and bake 5 minutes more.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip.
Serve with celery sticks.
Dice the tomato and onion and warm the pinto beans.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into 16 very thin strips and brush with the oil and smoked paprika.
Wrap each sausage in a strip of eggplant and pin with a toothpick.
Griddle until the eggplant is crisp and browned.
Tuck into the rolls with beans, tomato, onion, mustard and salsa.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until dark and crisp, then fill the skins with mushrooms and cheddar.
Bake again until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and chives.

veg.n: Graduation party lentil and mushroom rolls
veg.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until all the liquid has cooked off. Cool.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, fennel, soy, breadcrumbs, pepper and 1 beaten egg.
Halve the pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each strip and roll up, sealing with the other beaten egg.
Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C until golden and puffed.
Serve hot with tomato relish.
Crumble the smoked tofu finely.
Fold through the cream cheese with chopped dill, lemon zest and capers.
Spread thickly on rye crispbread.
Finish each with a squeeze of lemon.

veg.n: Paris café chocolate and spinach croissants

steps.text: Cut the pastry into long triangles.
Lay a stick of chocolate, or a pinch of spinach and cheese, at the wide end and roll up towards the point.
Curve into crescents and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Mix the plant-based mince with crushed garlic, cumin, chopped parsley and salt.
Roll into small balls.
Bake at 200C until browned.
Mix the yoghurt with the rest of the crushed garlic.
Spear each ball upright on a toothpick and serve with the yoghurt.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop and brush with melted butter. Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until dark.
Fill with cheddar and the mushrooms.
Bake again until crisp.
Top with sour cream and chives.
Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, soy, wombok, ginger and sliced spring onions.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry in the oil until crisp underneath.
Add water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in a little of the butter until dry, season with salt and pepper and cool.
Fill the wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed.
Boil until they float, plus 3 minutes.
Toss in the rest of the butter.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

veg.make_ahead: Keeps 1 week airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthways into thin 3mm strips.
Mix the soy, maple syrup, smoked paprika, pepper and crushed garlic and coat the mushrooms.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Lay on racks over trays.
Dry in the oven at 75C until chewy, turning once.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu up to 2 days chilled

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into 12 thick slabs and fry in the oil until golden on both sides.
Add the soy, sugar, ginger, star anise and 250ml water and simmer until sticky and glazed.
Slice the cucumber and pickle in the vinegar with a pinch of salt.
Steam the bao buns.
Fill with tofu, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.
Mix the miso with crushed garlic and the vegetable oil and coat the tofu.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill until charred.
Mix soy, sesame oil and sliced spring onion for dipping.
Salt the wombok, then squeeze it dry and mix with the mushrooms, crumbled tofu and a splash of the soy.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry in the oil until crisp underneath.
Add water and steam.
Serve with the rest of the soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Warm the cream, milk, sugar and split vanilla bean and leave to infuse.
Whisk in the agar, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Lift out the vanilla pod and pour into glasses.
Set in the fridge overnight.
Crush the meringue nests over the top like falling snow.

ingredients.item: smoked tofu, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Fry the tofu strips in the oil until crisp at the edges, adding the maple syrup for the last minute.
Split the rolls and butter them generously.
Stuff the tofu into each roll with a good squeeze of brown sauce.
Wrap tightly in paper so they stay warm.

veg.n: Normandy beach mushrooms in white wine

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, torn or thickly sliced

steps.text: Chop the eschalots and garlic.
Soften in some butter in a big pot.
Turn the heat up, add the mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add the wine, cover and simmer until the juices reduce by half.
Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up.

veg_af.n: Normandy beach mushrooms in garlic butter (alcohol-free)

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, torn or thickly sliced

steps.text: Chop the eschalots and garlic.
Soften in some butter in a big pot.
Turn the heat up, add the mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add the stock and verjuice, cover and simmer until the juices reduce by half.
Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up.

ingredients.item: grated ginger, plus slices for the broth

steps.text: Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, grated ginger, sesame oil and some soy.
Fill the wrappers and fold.
Simmer the stock with ginger slices and the rest of the soy.
Add the wontons and cook.
Add the bok choy for the last minute and load up the bowls.
Blitz the avocado, edamame, lime juice, garlic, coriander and salt until smooth and very green.
Spoon into a bowl.
Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Serve with rice crackers and cucumber for dipping.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the ale.
Add the cheddar, mustard and soy and stir over low heat until thick and smooth.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cut in half and serve hot.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the stock and malt vinegar.
Add the cheddar, mustard and soy and stir over low heat until thick and smooth.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cut in half and serve hot.

veg.n: Alva's shop bites with beetroot and dill

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon juice.
Spread on the crispbreads.
Top with the diced beetroot and slices of pickled onion.
Soak the breadcrumbs in milk.
Mix the plant-based mince with the soaked crumbs, egg, onion, allspice and salt.
Roll into 24 small balls.
Brown in butter.
Serve on toothpicks with cranberry sauce.
Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin, saving offcuts for stars.
Fill with fruit mince mixed with orange zest.
Top each with a small pastry star and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 190C.
Cool a little and dust with icing sugar.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled, bake fresh

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil, add the plant-based mince and brown it well. Stir in the flour, then the stock and soy, and simmer until thick. Cool completely.
Cut rounds from the shortcrust to line a patty tin and rounds from the puff for the lids. Fill the cases, top with the lids and press the edges to seal.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Squirt tomato sauce on top to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Best made the night before, keep chilled

steps.text: Put the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the sherry.
Bring the raspberry juice, agar and sugar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Pour over the sponge and chill until set.
Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.
Top with the raspberries just before serving.

veg_af.make_ahead: Best made the night before, keep chilled

steps.text: Put the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the orange juice.
Bring the raspberry juice, agar and sugar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Pour over the sponge and chill until set.
Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.
Top with the raspberries just before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble and grill fresh

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for a minute. Whisk in the milk and simmer until thick to make the bechamel.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until golden and dry.
Spread the bread with Dijon and fill with the mushrooms and some of the cheese.
Top with bechamel and the rest of the cheese. Grill until bubbling and golden, then cut into small squares.

veg.make_ahead: Batter and bake up to 3 hours ahead, toss in sauce fresh

steps.text: Whisk the flour, milk and salt into a thick batter and coat the cauliflower florets.
Bake on a lined tray at 220C until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce, toss the cauliflower through and bake 5 minutes more.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip. Serve with celery sticks.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled and warm to serve

steps.text: Slice the garlic and peel the citrus into strips.
Warm the olives gently in the oil with the peel, garlic, chilli and fennel seeds. Tip into a bowl and serve warm with toothpicks.

veg.make_ahead: Shape up to 4 hours ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Shape the plant-based mince into 8 small patties and season well with salt and pepper.
Fry for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar to each at the end.
Split the buns and add tomato sauce and pickles. Stack the patties in, scatter sesame seeds and push a toothpick through each.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, top just before serving

ingredients.item: blue food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Bring the water, sugar and agar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and blue colouring.
Drop a few raspberries into 4 clear cups and pour in the jelly.
Chill for 2 hours until set.
Spoon the custard over the jelly. Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top.
Finish with the crushed shortbread and the rest of the raspberries just before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, airtight

steps.text: Toss the almonds with the oil, rosemary and smoked salt on a tray.
Roast at 180C until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside the olives.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower florets in the buttermilk in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Mix the flour, paprika and salt. Lift the cauliflower out of the buttermilk and dredge in the flour.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until crisp and tender. Drain on paper and serve hot with the honey.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Whisk the eggs and caster sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Spread in a lined slice tin and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 12 rectangles.
Beat the butter, most of the icing sugar, marshmallow fluff and vanilla until fluffy. Sandwich pairs of cake with it.
Melt the chocolate with the cream and dip the cakes in it. Let them set.
Mix the leftover icing sugar with a few drops of water and pipe a white squiggle on top.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into bite-sized cubes. Mix the soy sauce, honey and ginger and toss the tofu through.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C until golden and sticky, turning once.
Spear on toothpicks and serve with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, top with cream to serve

ingredients.item: green food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Bring the water, sugar and agar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Take off the heat and stir in the lime juice and colouring. Halve most of the grapes.
Pour the jelly into clear glasses with the kiwifruit and halved grapes.
Chill for 2 hours until set.
Top with whipped cream and finish each glass with one whole grape like a jewel.

veg.n: Cheese and cucumber sandwiches, apple, nuts
veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the bread and fill with the cucumber, cheddar and relish. Cut into triangles.
Slice the apples and twist the nuts into paper cones.
Pack it all together like a lunch hidden away in a school attic.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Melt the chocolate. Stir in the marshmallows, almonds, biscuits and coconut.
Press into a lined tray and chill for 2 hours.
Smash into rough chunky rocks with the handle of a knife.

veg.make_ahead: Shape up to 4 hours ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Divide the plant-based mince into 16 thin patties. Sandwich half a slice of cheese between 2 patties and pinch the edges sealed to make 8.
Griddle 4 minutes a side, then rest 2 minutes so the cheese doesn't burst.
Serve in the slider buns with pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate until frothy.
Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top.

veg.n: Annexation of Puerto Rico cauliflower wings
veg.make_ahead: Dip up to 1 day, cauliflower fresh

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower with the oil and salt and roast at 220C until browned at the edges.
Warm the honey with the barbecue sauce, toss the cauliflower through and roast 5 minutes more.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise and herbs into a ranch dip. Serve with celery sticks.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled and covered

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool and peel.
Slice the cucumbers into thick rounds and top each with cream cheese, a folded slice of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Mash the eggs with salt and spread on the bread. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Toss the lentils with the soy and oil so they turn glossy and dark.
Warm the blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes.
Top each with a small spoon of creme fraiche, a little of the lentils and a few chives.
Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows.

veg.make_ahead: Make the night before, turn out on the day

ingredients.item: green food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Bring the water, sugar and agar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Take off the heat and stir in the lime juice and colouring.
Pour into a ring mould and chill overnight.
Dip the mould briefly in hot water and turn out wobbling onto a plate.
Fill the centre with cream and sliced kiwifruit.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Thread tomatoes, bocconcini, artichoke halves and basil onto skewers.
Lay on a platter and drizzle with oil and balsamic. Season.

veg.make_ahead: Rolls up to 1 day chilled, bake fresh

ingredients.item: chargrilled capsicum, chopped and patted dry

steps.text: Spread the pastry with tomato paste mixed with oregano. Scatter with capsicum and mozzarella.
Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly.
Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C until golden.
Rest for a couple of minutes before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

steps.text: Marinate the paneer in the yoghurt, cumin, garlic and salt for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast, turning, until charred.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Cauliflower fresh, sauce can be made ahead

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower with the oil and salt and roast at 220C until browned at the edges.
Melt the chilli sauce, honey and butter, toss the cauliflower through and roast 5 minutes more.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Soften the leek in the butter, add the mushrooms and cook until golden and dry.
Stir in the cream and tarragon and simmer until thick.
Spoon into the cases and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until golden and hot.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Brush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar.
Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges.
Serve with hummus, pickled turnips and olives in little bowls.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, one juiced and one for salsa

steps.text: Toss the haloumi with the oil, garlic, chilli and juice of 1 lime. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Dice the mango and mix with coriander and the juice of the second lime for the salsa.
Thread the haloumi onto skewers and grill until golden and charred. Serve with the salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, airtight

steps.text: Toss the nuts with the oil, rosemary and smoked salt on a tray.
Roast at 180C until fragrant. Serve warm in one bowl beside a second bowl of mixed olives.

veg.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, wombok, ginger and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam for 5 minutes.
Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: chopped dill, plus extra for the dip

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into chunks and marinate in most of the lemon juice with the dill, oil and salt for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 3 minutes a side until charred.
Stir more dill and the rest of the lemon through the yoghurt for a dip.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

ingredients.item: pistachios, plus extra crushed to serve

steps.text: Blend the pistachios with the milk until fine, then strain.
Warm the pistachio milk with the cream, sugar and agar. Bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour into glasses and set overnight.
Top with crushed pistachios and a drizzle of honey.

veg.n: Sumac flatbreads with beet and herb dips (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Dips up to 2 days, grill breads fresh

steps.text: Roast the beetroot at 200C until tender, then cool and peel.
Blend the beetroot with the garlic and some of the yoghurt for a pink dip. Stir the herbs through more yoghurt for a green dip.
Brush the flatbreads with oil, dust with sumac and turmeric and grill until blistered. Serve with the dips and hummus.

veg.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, steam fresh

ingredients.item: spring onions, sliced, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, ginger, spring onion and soy.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam for 10 minutes.
Serve a few in each bowl with hot stock, more spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.

veg.n: Panko tofu bites with honey mustard
veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into small oval football shapes and season with the salt.
Coat in flour, egg and panko.
Shallow fry in the oil until golden on all sides.
Mix the honey with the Dijon for dipping and pile the footballs on a platter.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower with the oil and salt and roast at 220C until browned at the edges.
Warm the honey, soy and chilli until sticky.
Toss the cauliflower through the glaze, roast 5 minutes more and scatter with sesame seeds.

veg.make_ahead: Make the night before, finish on the day

steps.text: Press the sponge cubes into a glass bowl. Bring the raspberry juice, agar and sugar to the boil, simmer for 2 minutes, stirring, and pour over.
Chill until set.
Layer with sliced mango, custard and whipped cream. Chill overnight.
Finish with gold sprinkles just before serving.

veg.n: Peruvian hearts of palm ceviche cups
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato until tender, then cool and cube. Cook the corn for 2 minutes and drain.
Slice the hearts of palm into rounds and cover with the lime juice and a good pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Add the onion, chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with the sweet potato and corn.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Bring the water, sugar and agar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Layer the grapes and blueberries in glasses and pour over the jelly.
Set for 4 hours in the fridge.

veg.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the onion, cumin, parsley and salt.
Shape around skewers and chill for 10 minutes so they hold.
Grill over high heat until charred and hot through.
Stir the harissa through the yoghurt and serve as a dip.

veg.n: Aegean dive grilled king brown mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 3 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one juiced and one in wedges

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms and marinate in the oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt for 30 minutes.
Grill on a very hot plate for 3 to 4 minutes a side until charred and tender.
Pile onto a plate, scatter with capers and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 hour, grill fresh

ingredients.item: king brown mushrooms, cut into thick coins
limes, one zested and the rest in wedges

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the garlic, chilli, lime zest, melted butter and salt.
Grill for 3 minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days, grill sausages fresh

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in the oil with the sugar until jammy.
Grill the sausages over coals until blistered and hot through.
Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and mustard.
